title: The Drowned Cellar
intro: You descend from the rain into an old potter's house. Somewhere below, they say, a heart of clay still beats.

things.name: stairwell
things.description: Wet stone steps spiral down into the dark. Rainwater trickles past your boots.

things.name: stone steps
things.description: Slick steps leading down. You hear water lapping below.

things.name: old shovel
things.description: A potter's clay shovel, its edge still sharp enough to hurt.

things.name: cellar
things.description: Ankle-deep black water covers the floor. An iron chest squats against one wall; an iron door is set into the east wall. One brick near the floor sits a little crooked.

things.name: iron door
things.description: Heavy iron, cold to the touch, with a rusted keyhole.

things.name: iron chest
things.description: A squat iron chest, half sunk in the water. The lid isn't locked, just heavy.

things.name: rusty key
things.description: A key flaked with orange rust.

things.name: crooked brick
things.description: On closer inspection the brick is loose. You push it, and it slides inward.

things.name: narrow gap
things.description: A gap where the wall used to be, barely wide enough to squeeze through.

things.name: goblin
things.description: A wiry goblin with a chipped dagger, standing guard in front of the iron door.

actor.persona: A cowardly but greedy goblin. Fights when cornered, flees when badly hurt.
actor.goal: Guard the iron door. Attack intruders who come close.

things.name: niche
things.description: A tight, dry space behind the wall. Someone scratched words into the plaster here.

things.name: scratched words
things.description: "The heart sleeps behind iron. The guard is a coward: hurt him, and he runs."

things.name: crypt
things.description: Shelves of small clay figures line the walls, hundreds of them, each one different. In the middle stands a low stone altar.

things.name: stone altar
things.description: A low altar, worn smooth by hands. Two hollows in the stone in front of it look like they were made by knees.

things.name: clay heart
things.description: A fist-sized heart of unfired clay. It is warm, and very faintly, it beats.

requires.fail: You open your mouth, and nothing comes out.

pray.summary: Kneel and pray. Some places listen.
pray.nothing: The stone is cold and silent.

then.say: With a dry scrape, a narrow gap opens in the wall.
The goblin hisses and shoves you away from the door.
The air in here is warm, like a kiln long after the fire went out.
As the heart leaves the altar, every clay figure on the shelves turns its head toward you.
Your throat goes cold. Something has taken your voice in exchange.
Under your palms the altar hums, and the heart on it beats a little faster.
The heart warms in your hands. Your voice comes back, hoarse, but yours.
In the stillness you hear it: hundreds of tiny clay feet shifting on the shelves. When you look up, every figure stands one step closer.
